short_description: A 5-day Grade 1 unit on non-standard measurement framed around Roo the Ruler Rabbit and Cal the Calendar Cat. Children name attributes, compare and order objects, and read a calendar.
long_description: Discover measurement with Roo and Cal! This 5-day Ontario-aligned Grade 1 unit covers all 3 E2 expectations (E2.1, E2.2, E2.3) through hands-on attribute identification, ordering, and calendar reading. Day 1 introduces 4 measurable attributes (length, area, mass, capacity). Day 2 compares by length and area using paper strips and area tiles. Day 3 compares by mass and capacity using a paper balance and pouring. Day 4 reads a calendar — days, weeks, months, holidays, seasons. Day 5 closes with a Measurement Day Capstone integrating all 3 expectations across 4 stations. Includes 5 lesson plans with expanded walkthroughs (each tackling a Grade-1 trap: mass-capacity mix-up, gap-cover, eyeball-mass, static-date, speed-trap), 5 student worksheets with answer keys, 12 paper manipulatives, formative + reflection sheets, full assessment suite with 3-row summative rubric, and Junior Measure-Master certificates. Pedagogical approach: concrete materials, structured pair work, Canadian holiday context.
